email_subject: Application - Cyber Security Assessment Team Coordinator
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Cyber Security Assessment Team Coordinator role at your multinational defence organisation in Mons. With a background in digital marketing, web development, and technical coordination, I have the organisational skills and attention to detail to support a cyber security assessment team.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage multiple client websites, coordinate content updates, and ensure that all deliverables are accurate and professional. My experience with SharePoint-based digital workplace projects at Knowledge Experts (KXP) for clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo has given me hands-on familiarity with document management and ticketing tools. I am comfortable with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams, and I have a strong proofreading ability.

While my direct experience with penetration testing terminology is limited, my technical background in computer science and web development allows me to quickly grasp cyber security concepts. I am fluent in English and eager to bring my organisational skills to a team where precision and coordination are key.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Cyber Security Assessment Team Coordinator position at your multinational defence organisation in Mons. With a strong background in digital marketing, web development, and technical coordination, I am confident in my ability to support a cyber security assessment team with organisation, precision, and a keen eye for detail.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage multiple client websites, coordinate content updates, and ensure that all deliverables meet high standards of accuracy and professionalism. This experience has honed my ability to juggle multiple deadlines, maintain meticulous records, and communicate effectively with team members and clients. Additionally, my work at Knowledge Experts (KXP) involved supporting the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for major clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo. This gave me hands-on experience with document management systems and ticketing tools, which are directly relevant to the coordinator role.

I am proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including advanced Word (styles, templates, track changes), Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams. My proofreading skills are sharp, and I understand the importance of presenting reports that are clean and consistent. While my direct experience with penetration testing terminology is limited, my technical background in computer science and web development, including front-end development at ViviDoctor, has equipped me with the ability to quickly grasp cyber security concepts and work comfortably alongside technical experts.

I am fluent in English and have a careful approach to sensitive information. I am eager to bring my organisational skills to a central coordination seat within a specialist cyber team, where a good organiser is noticed quickly. I am confident that my ability to manage calendars, organise travel, track actions, and maintain records in tools like Power BI, SharePoint, Confluence, Jira, ServiceNow, and Excel would make me a valuable asset to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to the smooth running of your cyber security assessment team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
